name: Amagi Ryou
source:
• Zodiac sign: Scorpio

A preceptor of a Hospital University who became Takuya's senpai when he was transferred to internal medicine for training.

She is gentle to children, elders, and female patients, but she often shows her sadistic side to any male with no hesitation, even to Takuya, who often is teased during lessons. Regardless, she can take good care of others and is known to be very reliable during work.

As the president's niece of the Amagi Hospital University, she was assigned as a doctor supervisor even though she was young and inexperienced.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1770840/]Steam[/url]]
